overview_description.description: CoVerified is making public health data usable for large, complex populations. It develops HIPAA-compliant enterprise software with integrations between healthcare data sources and the populations that depend on it.  During the pandemic, it focused on solutions linking testing and symptom data to end-user behaviors such as access to buildings. Currently, its platforms serve over 200,000 users and have processed more than two million COVID-19 tests. CoVerified is also part of the Y Combinator W21 Batch.
